How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Run by a couple

Guests write about a husband and wife who welcome you, and a chef who comes to the table to ask if everything is alright.

Bread, olives and tzatziki

Several guests mention warm bread with olives and tzatziki that comes to the table on the house.

Vegetarian dishes

Guests write that there are vegetarian dishes, including a vegetarian moussaka.

At the old power station

Palia Ilektriki means the old electric company. The restaurant is a little hidden on the grounds of the old power station in the Paphos old town, at Vladimirou Irakleous 8. Guests eat on a modern terrace under white sunshades, and an old generator still stands outside. Guests advise following Google Maps to find it.

What guests say

Three of 510 Google reviews, 447 of them with five stars.

“Incredibly delicious! Truly a hidden gem. Quiet location, super friendly service, and the chef personally comes to the table to ask if everything is alright. A rare experience. We had shrimp and lamb as our main course. We've rarely eaten so well.”

Google review
“Authentic Greek food. Off the tourist trap. Follow Google maps. Outstanding food and hospitality. The vine leaves and halloumi were to die for, followed by Moussaka and lamb Kleftiko as a main, washed down with a lovely red wine. Complimentary bread (warm) olives and tzaziki-who could ask for more? Highly recommend.”

Google review
“Very relaxed and hidden restaurant with fresh and very delicious food with super friendly service. We had chicken, pork and fish and every dish was freshly prepared and very tasty. The portions are big and the prices are decent. I can recommend this restaurant!”
